_comment: One is picked per day by scripts/render.mjs, by day of year, so the cycle is stable and repeats. Keep each statement under six short lines: the renderer wraps at 52 characters and the card is sized for eight lines of body.

theorems.statement: Let P be a paper and t the time since you opened it. Then the probability of having read the abstract tends to 1, while the probability of having read Section 4 stays bounded above by 1/t.
theorems.proof: Immediate from the definition of "I'll come back to this".

theorems.statement: Every citation graph contains a cycle of length 2 in which both authors are certain the other one is wrong.
theorems.proof: Construct the cycle. It is already there.

theorems.statement: The number of open PDF tabs is non-decreasing in time, and any attempt to close one strictly increases it.
theorems.proof: By induction on Tuesday.

theorems.statement: A deadline is a fixed point of the map that sends "next week" to "next week".
theorems.proof: Apply Banach. The map is a contraction only in the supervisor's metric.

theorems.statement: For any experiment E, the seed that produced the good result is not the seed that was committed.
theorems.proof: Suppose not. Then the result reproduces, contradicting experience.

theorems.statement: Let R be a rebuttal of length n. The reviewer's reading of R has length O(1), independent of n.
theorems.proof: Observe that the constant is 1, and it is the first sentence.

theorems.statement: Any codebase left unattended for six months becomes indistinguishable from a codebase written by someone else.
theorems.proof: The author is that someone else. Apply the definition.

theorems.statement: The expected time to "just quickly check one thing" diverges.
theorems.proof: The integrand is positive and the upper limit is dinner.

theorems.statement: In any grid search over k hyperparameters, the optimum lies on the boundary, and the boundary was chosen to be safe.
theorems.proof: Extend the range. The claim holds again, one range out.

theorems.statement: Coffee is not sufficient for understanding a proof, but no counterexample has been produced without it.
theorems.proof: Left to the reader, after a coffee.

theorems.statement: Let S be the set of papers you intend to read this weekend. Then S is finite, and its measure on Monday is zero.
theorems.proof: S is finite because your disk is. The rest is observation.

theorems.statement: Every figure is legible at the size you made it and at no other size.
theorems.proof: Scale it for the camera-ready version and check.

theorems.statement: For all sufficiently long proofs, there exists a step labelled "clearly" that consumed a week.
theorems.proof: Take the longest such step. It is the one.

theorems.statement: The last bug is not the last bug.
theorems.proof: Suppose it were. Then the tests would pass, which is absurd.

theorems.statement: A model's validation accuracy is a decreasing function of the number of people watching the screen.
theorems.proof: Demonstrate it in front of a committee.

theorems.statement: Any theorem numbered 4.1 is the one the referee will ask about.
theorems.proof: By symmetry, so is 4.2, but only after 4.1 is fixed.

theorems.statement: There is no finite set of notebooks that covers a research project.
theorems.proof: Given any finite cover, open Untitled37.ipynb.

theorems.statement: The abstract is written last, describes a paper that does not exist yet, and is the only part anyone reads.
theorems.proof: Three observations, no contradiction among them.

theorems.statement: If a script runs on the first try, the input was empty.
theorems.proof: Check the input. It was empty.

theorems.statement: Let C be a set of contest problems sorted by difficulty. Then the one you can solve is at index |C|, and the contest ends at index |C| - 1.
theorems.proof: Standard. See every contest.

theorems.statement: Renaming a variable to make the code clearer creates exactly one new bug, and it is in the other file.
theorems.proof: Grep for the old name. You missed one.

theorems.statement: The energy required to start writing exceeds the energy required to write.
theorems.proof: Both are measurable. Only the first is ever spent.
